title: Open When Letters: aggregate statistics from 56,670 digital letters
description: How people write, lock and open "Open When" letters, short letters a recipient is told to open at a particular moment. Aggregate metadata from every letter sealed on OpenWhen (openwhen.cards) from 2026-02-04 to 2026-11-03: titles, opening times, question and date locks, countries, occasion spikes and optional extras. No letter text was read; every figure covers at least 50 letters. Summary with charts: https://www.openwhen.cards/open-when-letters-study
